description:
A meteor is hurtling toward Super Animal World, and it lands March 31 with the Bright Future Update (v2.1)! It’s Super Animal Royale’s first major update following the v2.0 Super Animal World expansion, which added a cozy Social Hub with fishing, bug catching, hamsterball racing, storytelling, and quests.

The Banananite meteor's impact kicks off a new storyline with new quests, new characters, and a retro-future sci-fi theme across the season and the Bright Future Animal Pass. Grab new weapons like the X-Ray Cannon, Uzis, and Dualzies, plus Banan Altars for rare loot (or curses), and new Super Animals from bio-engineered “Alien” breeds to space-ready Super Gorillas and Chimps. v2.1 also brings community-requested improvements like faster matchmaking with Play Again + Auto-Accept Queue, Hot Mode (a featured mode each day gives bonus XP), and easier ways to join friends’ Social Hubs.

Ghost of Yōtei Legends arrives as a free update for all Ghost of Yōtei owners.

Choose your path: Samurai, Archer, Mercenary, or Shinobi. Take on two-player Story missions, brutal Incursions and relentless four-player Survival.

Craft your build, unlock powerful gear, and prepare for the upcoming Raid: True four-player co-op where you must stand together, or fall to The Dragon and Lord Saito.

Take flight in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler 2000, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

🛩️ Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
🌀Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish!

🎨 Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 
🛠️ Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home.
